subject: SKU catalog & billing setup for AWS/Azure/GCP listings
messages:
From: Janelle Kim <janelle.kim@cloudpilot.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-05T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing — SKU & billing questions

Hi Lauren / Vanessa,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood marketplace intake yesterday. We've started filling out your vendor onboarding form and ran into two items that would affect our billing mapping across AWS, Azure and GCP:

- SKU granularity: do you prefer one SKU per offering (e.g., "CP-Core-Standard") or one SKU per platform+tier (e.g., "CP-Core-Standard-aws")? Our finance team leans toward platform-specific SKUs to avoid cross-cloud reconciliation delays.
- PO flow: we typically push a single master PO for quarterly consumption and then send monthly invoices. Your marketplace listing appears to require per-listing billing tokens for usage — can you confirm how that maps to a PO?

Attached: completed vendor onboarding form (partial), initial SKU mapping CSV export.

Attachment stubs: [CloudPilot_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 86 KB)], [CP_SKU_mapping_sheet.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]

Would love a short call or an example of a completed mapping from another vendor if possible. We're targeting a mid-November launch window.

Best,
Janelle
Procurement Lead
CloudPilot Solutions

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Kim <janelle.kim@cloudpilot.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-05T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — SKU & billing questions

Hi Janelle — great to meet you and thanks for sending the form. Short answers up front so you can keep momentum: 

1) SKU strategy: we recommend platform-specific SKUs (e.g., CP-Core-Standard-aws, CP-Core-Standard-azure, CP-Core-Standard-gcp) when the pricing or metering rules differ by cloud. That makes marketplace reconciliation and reporting easier for both sides. If your pricing is identical across clouds we can support a single SKU with a platform dimension, but the listing will need per-platform billing tokens.

2) PO / billing mapping: Redwood supports a master PO model. For marketplace listings we create a mapping table that links marketplace billing tokens (the token each cloud returns in usage records) to your internal PO line. The typical flow we use:
  - You send master PO to Redwood Procurement -> attach to Deal ID
  - We create marketplace SKU mappings and return a mapping table for your AP team to reconcile
  - Invoices are issued monthly against the PO using the mapped line items

I'll kick off the mapping process internally. Ben and Karthik — can you pick this up? Ben, please review the attached CSV and propose the SKU naming convention for the listing. Karthik, once Ben confirms, can you prepare the DocuSign PO template and the marketplace-specific billing token mapping (AWS Metering ID / Azure Marketplace SKU ID / GCP billing line)?

Janelle — we'll also share a sample mapping from a previous vendor (anonymized) so you can see the format. I attached the Redwood PO template if you'd like to draft the master PO.

Attachment stubs: [signed_po_template.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)]

Next step: Ben to reply with suggested SKU names and Karthik to open a DocuSign envelope for the PO by EOD tomorrow. Are those timelines workable for you?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-06T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — SKU & billing questions

Lauren / Karthik — quick internal checklist before we hand the mapping back to CloudPilot: 

- Review CP_SKU_mapping_sheet.csv and normalize names to our marketplace style guide (lowercase components, hyphen separators).
- Create explicit platform SKUs for any tier that has platform-specific quotas or pricing.
- Flag any meter differences (e.g., tokenized usage vs. file-size billing) that require separate meter IDs.
- Confirm tax jurisdiction for the vendor (CloudPilot listed as US-CA). If tax exempt, note reason and capture exemption docs.

I've updated one example row in the CSV to show our preferred format: cp-core-standard-aws -> marketplace_name: CP Core (Standard) | marketplace_sku: cp-core-standard-aws | meter_id: aws_mtr_9812.

Karthik — once you have the meter_id list, I'll generate the final mapping and send to Janelle with a short reconciliation example. If CloudPilot wants a single master PO, we'll attach the PO to the mapping table and include the DocuSign link in the email.

Ben
Sr. Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Janelle Kim <janelle.kim@cloudpilot.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-07T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — SKU & billing questions

Thanks, all — this is very helpful. We prefer platform-specific SKUs and CloudPilot confirms US-CA tax status (we'll upload the exemption certificate to your Drive).

Next steps on our side:
- We'll sign the MSA redlines and return by EOD Thursday. (Attachment: MSA_CloudPilot_redlines.docx)
- Procurement will issue the master PO and sign via DocuSign — please send the envelope when ready.
- I'll upload the finalized SKU CSV after internal legal review so Ben can finalize the mapping.

Attachment stubs: [MSA_CloudPilot_redlines.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)]

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Targeting live listing by Nov 19.

Best,
Janelle
Procurement Lead
CloudPilot Solutions
